sprint: Sprint 10: Convergence Intelligence and Adaptive Constraint Governance
evidence_base: 4 Sprint 9 pilot runs + Sprint 8/9 historical repair data

convergence_confidence_model.definition: Convergence confidence = probability that a given scenario will reach EXAMPLE_READY_FOR_PR_DRY_RUN on the next run, based on historical failure classification and constraint fixes applied.

pdf-jpeg.confidence_basis: Deterministic failure with known root cause. Fix is exact constraint. API usage was correct in Sprint 9 final run — only filename was wrong.
risk_factors: LLM may still use different filename despite constraint; repair loop should catch it

pdf-tiff.confidence_basis: Same root cause as Jpeg. Fix is exact. API usage was correct.
risk_factors: Minor: .tif vs .tiff ambiguity may persist if LLM ignores constraint

pdf-png.confidence_basis: Passed last run. Some probabilistic risk from LLM non-determinism.
risk_factors: Non-deterministic: Png failed in run 2 (runtime) and run 3 (generation), passed in run 4

pdf-doc-converter.confidence_basis: Failed generation in runs 1 and 3. Passed in run 4. High non-determinism for PdfToDocOptions constraint.
risk_factors: LLM frequently attempts PdfConverterOptions (abstract) instead of PdfToDocOptions

pdf-html.confidence_basis: Failed in runs 1, 2, 3. Passed in run 4 only. Html fixture pattern (HTML file, not PDF) is frequently misunderstood by LLM.
risk_factors: LLM creates PDF Document fixture instead of HTML file in majority of runs; FORBIDDEN constraint is bypassed when HtmlToPdfOptions is present

pdf-merger.confidence_basis: Passes consistently after TextFragment using-directive constraint fix (Sprint 8).
risk_factors: Low: using Aspose.Pdf.Text fix is stable

pdf-optimizer.confidence_basis: Failed generation in run 3. Passes in 2/4 runs. OptimizeOptions constraint satisfied inconsistently.
risk_factors: LLM sometimes generates incomplete repair for Optimizer

pdf-pdf-aconverter.confidence_basis: Failed in runs 2 and 3. PdfAConvertOptions is a non-obvious class name for the LLM.
risk_factors: LLM occasionally generates options that satisfy AddInput/AddOutput but not PdfAConvertOptions class constraint

repair_success_weighting.observation: Build repair (max 1 attempt) succeeds ~80% of the time when the issue is a missing using directive or wrong class name. Runtime repair (max 1 attempt) succeeds ~40% of the time due to the repair prompt receiving 28 constraints (signal dilution).
repair_success_weighting.recommendation: Reduce runtime repair constraint injection to only the type-specific REQUIRED/FORBIDDEN constraints (not all 28 global pdf_constraints). This reduces noise in the repair prompt.

recurring_failure_signatures.description: LLM creates LowCodeLoadOptions object without setting InputFile or InputStream. Not a valid pattern for PDF LowCode API.
recurring_failure_signatures.fix_status: PARTIALLY_FIXED — repair prompt includes 'use simple string-path overload' guidance; still occurs probabilistically
recurring_failure_signatures.recommended_action: Add FORBIDDEN: LowCodeLoadOptions to packet_builder.py hardcoded constraints

recurring_failure_signatures.description: LLM uses wrong file extension for output path (output.pdf for Jpeg; output.tif for Tiff).
recurring_failure_signatures.fix_status: FIXED in Sprint 10 — literal-string REQUIRED constraint added

recurring_failure_signatures.description: Html plugin requires HTML file input, but LLM creates PDF Document fixture. Occurs in ~75% of Html runs.
recurring_failure_signatures.fix_status: PARTIALLY_FIXED — FORBIDDEN constraint for Document fixture creation; REQUIRED constraint for File.WriteAllText
recurring_failure_signatures.recommended_action: Add few-shot example for Html type to LLM prompt

adaptive_steering_recommendations.recommendation: Add FORBIDDEN: LowCodeLoadOptions to packet_builder.py hardcoded PDF constraints
adaptive_steering_recommendations.rationale: LowCodeLoadOptions appears in 5 of 11 type repair cycles; always wrong; always caught by repair but wastes repair budget
adaptive_steering_recommendations.impact: Reduce average repair attempts per type from 1.3 to <1.0

adaptive_steering_recommendations.recommendation: Add Html-specific few-shot example to llm-fewshot-patterns.json
adaptive_steering_recommendations.rationale: Html has 60% convergence confidence (lowest); the HTML-vs-PDF input confusion is the primary cause

adaptive_steering_recommendations.recommendation: Reduce runtime repair constraint injection from all pdf_constraints (28) to type-specific only
adaptive_steering_recommendations.rationale: 28 constraints creates signal dilution in runtime repair prompt. Type-specific 6-8 constraints is more focused.

adaptive_steering_recommendations.recommendation: Add probabilistic_confidence field to lifecycle records
adaptive_steering_recommendations.rationale: Current lifecycle records don't distinguish deterministic vs probabilistic failures. This field enables smarter rerun scheduling.

lane3_verdict: ADAPTIVE_HEALING_INTELLIGENCE_ESTABLISHED — Convergence confidence scores computed for 8 scenarios. 3 recurring failure signatures documented. 4 adaptive steering recommendations ranked. Framework is now operational for future sprint planning.
